items.title: Circana分析师警告：AI vibe coding将成Steam最大问题
items.author: Pirat_Nation
items.summary: 游戏市场分析机构Circana分析师Mat Piscatella警告，AI vibe coding正在加速Steam平台的内容泛滥。用简单提示就能快速生成游戏，成功作品会被快速克隆和淹没。
items.analysis: "好游戏会被克隆和掩埋"——这是AI对游戏发行生态的根本性威胁。当制作门槛趋近于零，发现机制（而非制作能力）将成为核心竞争力。Steam的推荐算法将面临史无前例的压力。
items.recommendation: 分析师警告AI vibe coding将让Steam好游戏被克隆淹没，发现机制成核心挑战
items.full_text:
AI “vibe coding” could become one of the biggest problems for game stores like Steam, according to Circana analyst Mat Piscatella.

Vibe coding uses AI to build games from simple prompts, speeding up new project creation and Piscatella warns that this could also make it easier to copy successful games and quickly release similar versions.

“Good games will get cloned and buried,” He also warned that “players will default to games and franchises they know and trust. Breaking through will become even more difficult.” 

He added that the growing number of AI-made games could worsen Steam’s discovery problem, saying

“Massive counterpoint to anyone claiming that AI will help the video game market by lowering development time and cost… it’s… bad!” “Seems unstoppable at this point.”

items.title: Aaron Levie：代码可测试性是AI agent在编程领域领先的核心原因
items.author: Aaron Levie
items.summary: Box CEO Aaron Levie分析为何AI agent在代码领域进展最快：代码可以快速测试验证，而销售话术、合同谈判等工作只有在实际执行后才能验证效果。
items.analysis: 这个洞察揭示了AI agent的扩展路径——从"可测试"领域向"不可测试"领域延伸。游戏开发同时具有两面：代码可测试但游戏体验不可自动测试，这决定了AI替代的边界。
items.recommendation: 代码能快速测试所以AI agent在编程领域最强——其他领域需要新的验证范式
items.full_text:
One of the many properties that code has that makes it highly amenable to agents is that you can more or less quickly test it. You can either go see if the application works manually, or you can actually run a test on what you built.

Most other areas of work don’t have this benefit. You only get the testing when the final product hits the real world in some capacity - a stock trade is executed, a contract is negotiated, a sales pitch is delivered, and so on.

There’s probably going to be a whole new set of opportunities for how we begin to test the rest of work in this way. Ultimately it will mean more agents being layered into workflows. 

It also means we need much better evals on most of our workflows. Most work today in enterprises doesn’t have an associated eval to know if something broke or improved with a model, prompt, or system change.

The enterprises that are able to eval their knowledge work the best also stand to gain the most from AI. Will become a critical aspect of agent adoption over time.

items.title: 调查：100%日本在线游戏开发商正在使用生成式AI
items.author: Eurogamer
items.summary: 一项调查显示日本在线游戏开发商已100%采用生成式AI，但主要用于"用户偏好分析"而非直接内容创作。与此同时版权侵权担忧持续上升。
items.analysis: 100%渗透率的数据意味着AI已从实验阶段进入生产常态。但用途集中在分析而非创作，说明日本开发商对AI生成内容的版权风险态度谨慎——这与欧美indie的激进使用形成鲜明对比。
items.recommendation: 日本游戏业AI渗透率达100%，但用于分析而非创作——版权担忧是关键制约

items.title: World Labs+Fable+ThreeJS：AI驱动的沉浸式3D场景生成
items.author: Brittani Natali
items.summary: 开发者Brittani Natali展示World Labs+Fable+ThreeJS的组合效果：AI生成3D场景并直接在浏览器中实时渲染，视觉沉浸感令人印象深刻。

items.title: "没人在Xbox Studios能感到安全"——裁员恐惧报告揭露内部危机
items.author: Eurogamer
items.summary: 新报告揭示Xbox Studios内部弥漫着不确定和恐惧氛围。大规模裁员导致"惊人的"机构知识流失，剩余员工士气低落。报告引述员工称"不知道留在Xbox的人怎么能感到安全"。
items.analysis: 这是继Bethesda裁员后Xbox内部问题的系统性曝光。"机构知识流失"是最深层的伤害——当资深开发者离开，项目的历史决策和技术积累随之消失，新员工需要重新摸索。
items.recommendation: Xbox裁员报告：恐惧弥漫、知识流失惊人，员工直言无人能感到安全

items.title: Dead Space创始人Glen Schofield宣布退休
items.author: PC Gamer
items.summary: Dead Space创始人、曾操刀三代Call of Duty的游戏行业老兵Glen Schofield宣布退休，结束数十年的一线游戏开发生涯。

items.title: 前R星制作人：GTA 6不上PC是因为"从约束开始更好"
items.author: PC Gamer

items.title: 枪击手感设计方法论：无实枪经验开发者的完整指南
items.author: Crunio
items.summary: 日本CG媒体Crunio报道Unity开发者FcsVorfeed_Dev的枪击手感设计经验：通过研究CoD和The Division，调整反动、枪口闪光、特效和镜头演出，在没有实枪经验的情况下实现舒适的射击反馈。
items.analysis: 射击手感是FPS/TPS品类的核心体验要素，但很少有系统性的方法论分享。这篇报道将"感觉对"拆解为可调参数（反动曲线、视觉反馈、镜头震动），对独游FPS开发者极有参考价值。
items.recommendation: 没摸过真枪也能做出好枪感——反动、闪光、镜头演出的完整调参方法论
items.full_text:
実銃経験がない開発者が「気持ちいい銃撃感」をどう再現するか
